description: Geoserver is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Localização das atividades e empreendimentos submetidos ao licenciamento ambiental federal. Não há uma escala específica pois as informações são encaminhadas pelas empresas interessadas ao solicitar a abertura do processo. Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 18 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are Economia (005), planningCadastre. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
